title: Interventricular Cardiac Septal Thickness in Fetus of Diabetic Mother Correlated to Postnatal Outcome
brief_summary: Good glycemic control is superior to poor glycemic control in reducing risk of interventricular septal thickness among fetuses of diabetic mothers.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* above 35 weeks pregnancy
* diabetic mothers
* single intrauterine pregnancy

Exclusion Criteria:

* any other medical disorder
condition: Maternal Diabetes Mellites Effect on Fetus
